benefitDescription.en: ₹6,000/year in 3 instalments of ₹2,000 each

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must own cultivable land. Institutional landholders, income tax payers, and government employees are excluded.

benefitDescription.en: Crop insurance at subsidised premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticulture crops. Full sum insured on crop loss.
benefitDescription.hi: फसल बीमा: खरीफ 2%, रबी 1.5%, वाणिज्यिक 5% प्रीमियम पर। फसल नुकसान पर पूरी बीमा राशि।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops. Voluntary for all farmers.

benefitDescription.en: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest (effective 4% with prompt repayment subvention). Collateral-free up to ₹1.6 lakh.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹3 लाख तक फसल ऋण 7% ब्याज पर (समय पर भुगतान पर 4%)। ₹1.6 लाख तक बिना गारंटी।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Farmers, fishermen, animal husbandry and dairy farmers. Also available through PM Matsya Sampada for fisheries.

benefitDescription.en: Free soil testing and health card with crop-wise fertiliser recommendations. Now merged under RKVY as 'Soil Health & Fertility' component.
benefitDescription.hi: मुफ्त मिट्टी परीक्षण और फसलवार उर्वरक सिफारिशों के साथ स्वास्थ्य कार्ड।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All farmers can get soil tested free of charge

benefitDescription.en: Subsidy on micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler): 55% for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others. 'Per Drop More Crop' initiative.
benefitDescription.hi: सूक्ष्म सिंचाई (ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर) पर सब्सिडी: छोटे किसानों को 55%, अन्य को 45%।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All farmers with own or leased land. Priority to small and marginal farmers.

name.hi: पीएम कुसुम (किसानों के लिए सौर ऊर्जा)

benefitDescription.en: 60% subsidy (30% central + 30% state) on solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants for farmers. Extended till March 2026.
benefitDescription.hi: सौर पंप और सौर ऊर्जा संयंत्रों पर 60% सब्सिडी (30% केंद्र + 30% राज्य)।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Farmers, water user associations, farmer producer organisations

benefitDescription.en: ₹1.20 lakh (plains) / ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for construction of pucca house with basic amenities.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹1.20 लाख (मैदान) / ₹1.30 लाख (पहाड़ी क्षेत्र) पक्के मकान निर्माण हेतु।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house. Selected from SECC 2011 data.

benefitDescription.en: 4% interest subsidy on first ₹8 lakh of home loan for 12 years (up to ₹1.8 lakh subsidy). Max house value ₹35 lakh, max loan ₹25 lakh.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹8 लाख होम लोन पर 4% ब्याज सब्सिडी 12 वर्षों के लिए (अधिकतम ₹1.8 लाख सब्सिडी)।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: EWS (income up to ₹3L), LIG (₹3-6L), MIG (₹6-9L). Must not own pucca house anywhere in India. House in female/joint name.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation. Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals. Senior citizens 70+ get additional ₹5 lakh top-up.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹5 लाख प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष अस्पताल में भर्ती के लिए। 70+ वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को अतिरिक्त ₹5 लाख।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Bottom 40% poor and vulnerable families as per SECC 2011. ~12 crore families (~55 crore beneficiaries). All senior citizens 70+ regardless of income.

benefitDescription.en: Accidental death & disability insurance at ₹20/year premium. ₹2 lakh for death/total disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹20/वर्ष प्रीमियम पर दुर्घटना बीमा। मृत्यु/पूर्ण विकलांगता पर ₹2 लाख, आंशिक विकलांगता पर ₹1 लाख।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have a bank account with Aadhaar linked. Annual auto-debit consent required.

benefitDescription.en: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh at ₹436/year premium. Covers death due to any reason.
benefitDescription.hi: ₹436/वर्ष प्रीमियम पर ₹2 लाख जीवन बीमा। किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु पर।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have bank account with Aadhaar linked. Annual auto-debit consent. Cover continues till age 55.

benefitDescription.en: Quality generic medicines at 50-80% cheaper than branded medicines through 17,990+ Jan Aushadhi Kendras. Target 25,000 by 2027.
benefitDescription.hi: 17,990+ जनऔषधि केंद्रों पर ब्रांडेड दवाओं से 50-80% सस्ती गुणवत्तापूर्ण जेनेरिक दवाइयाँ।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Available to all citizens. No registration required.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5,000 for first child (in 3 instalments) + ₹6,000 for second child if girl. Total up to ₹11,000.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child. Second instalment for girl child only.

benefitDescription.en: Savings scheme for girl child with 8.2% p.a. interest (compounded annually). Min ₹250/year, max ₹1.5 lakh/year. Matures in 21 years. Tax-free under 80C.
benefitDescription.hi: बालिकाओं के लिए 8.2% वार्षिक ब्याज की बचत योजना। न्यूनतम ₹250/वर्ष, अधिकतम ₹1.5 लाख/वर्ष। 21 वर्ष में परिपक्वता।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girl child up to 10 years old. Max 2 accounts per family. Parent/guardian opens the account.

benefitDescription.en: Awareness campaign and multi-sectoral action to improve child sex ratio, girls' education and empowerment. No direct cash benefit.
benefitDescription.hi: बाल लिंगानुपात सुधार, बालिका शिक्षा और सशक्तिकरण हेतु जागरूकता अभियान। कोई प्रत्यक्ष नकद लाभ नहीं।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Nationwide awareness and enforcement programme. Benefits delivered through convergence with other schemes.

name.en: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)
name.hi: मनरेगा (महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम)

benefitDescription.en: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year per rural household. Daily wage ₹267-₹370 (varies by state, revised April 2025).
benefitDescription.hi: प्रति ग्रामीण परिवार प्रति वर्ष 100 दिन रोजगार गारंटी। दैनिक मजदूरी ₹267-₹370 (राज्यानुसार)।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work. Must have job card.

benefitDescription.en: Collateral-free working capital loans: ₹10,000 (1st), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd tranche). 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment. Extended till 2027.
benefitDescription.hi: बिना गारंटी कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण: ₹10,000 (पहला), ₹20,000 (दूसरा), ₹50,000 (तीसरा)। समय पर भुगतान पर 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Street vendors with certificate of vending/ID issued by ULB or Letter of Recommendation.

benefitDescription.en: Skill training, toolkit incentive (₹15,000), and concessional loans: ₹1 lakh (Phase 1) + ₹2 lakh (Phase 2) at 5% interest. For 18 traditional trades/artisans.
benefitDescription.hi: कौशल प्रशिक्षण, टूलकिट (₹15,000), रियायती ऋण: ₹1 लाख + ₹2 लाख 5% ब्याज पर। 18 पारंपरिक व्यवसायों के लिए।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Self-employed artisans/craftspersons in 18 family-based traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, cobbler, tailor, etc.)

benefitDescription.en: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000-₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5-10 lakh), Tarun Plus (₹10-20 lakh).

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. For manufacturing, trading, and service activities.

benefitDescription.en: Bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises by SC/ST and women entrepreneurs. Repayable in 7 years with 18-month moratorium.
benefitDescription.hi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों को नए उद्यम हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक बैंक ऋण। 7 वर्षों में चुकौती।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: For SC/ST entrepreneurs and women of any category. One borrower per bank branch per category.

benefitDescription.en: DPIIT recognition with benefits: 3-year income tax exemption (out of first 10 years), 80% patent fee rebate, self-certification for labour/environment laws, Fund of Funds access.
benefitDescription.hi: DPIIT मान्यता: 3 वर्ष आयकर छूट, 80% पेटेंट शुल्क छूट, फंड ऑफ फंड्स तक पहुँच।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Entity incorporated < 10 years ago. Turnover < ₹100 crore in any financial year. Working towards innovation/scalable business model.

benefitDescription.en: Margin money subsidy: 15-35% on projects up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (service). Higher subsidy for SC/ST/OBC/women/minorities/NE region.
benefitDescription.hi: मार्जिन मनी सब्सिडी: ₹50 लाख (विनिर्माण) / ₹20 लाख (सेवा) परियोजनाओं पर 15-35%।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: 8th pass for manufacturing projects > ₹10 lakh, service > ₹5 lakh. New projects only. SC/ST/OBC/women/minorities/ex-servicemen/disabled get higher subsidy (25-35%).

benefitDescription.en: Government shares 25% of stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) with employers for apprentices. Promotes on-the-job training. Active till March 2026.
benefitDescription.hi: सरकार शिक्षुओं के वजीफे का 25% (₹1,500/माह तक) नियोक्ताओं के साथ साझा करती है।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Youth enrolled in apprenticeship training in establishments. Employers with 4+ workforce eligible to engage apprentices.

benefitDescription.en: Free short-term skill training (150-300 hours) with industry-relevant certification. Includes assessment, certification and placement support.
benefitDescription.hi: उद्योग-प्रासंगिक प्रमाणपत्र के साथ मुफ्त अल्पकालिक कौशल प्रशिक्षण (150-300 घंटे)।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Indian youth, school/college dropouts, unemployed. Aadhaar and bank account required.

benefitDescription.en: Scholarships for OBC, EBC, DNT students: ₹75,000/year (Class 9-10) and ₹1,25,000/year (Class 11-12) at top schools. Also covers college education.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: OBC/EBC/DNT students with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh/year. Must qualify YASASVI Entrance Test (YET).

benefitDescription.en: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for students in top 860 NIRF-ranked institutions. 75% interest subvention for family income up to ₹8 lakh. Full interest subvention for income up to ₹4.5 lakh.
benefitDescription.hi: शीर्ष 860 NIRF संस्थानों के छात्रों को बिना गारंटी शिक्षा ऋण। ₹8 लाख तक आय पर 75% ब्याज सब्सिडी।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students admitted to top 860 NIRF-ranked higher education institutions. Outlay ₹3,600 crore for 2024-31.

benefitDescription.en: Integrated school education scheme covering pre-school to Class 12. Includes free textbooks, uniforms, mid-day meals, teacher training, and ICT infrastructure.
benefitDescription.hi: प्री-स्कूल से कक्षा 12 तक एकीकृत स्कूली शिक्षा योजना। मुफ्त पुस्तकें, वर्दी, मध्याह्न भोजन शामिल।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All students in government and aided schools. Special focus on CWSN, girls, SC/ST students.

benefitDescription.en: Free cooked nutritious meal to students in government and aided schools (Class 1-8). Also covers pre-primary (bal vatika).
benefitDescription.hi: सरकारी विद्यालयों में कक्षा 1-8 के छात्रों को मुफ्त पका हुआ पोषक भोजन।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students of government, government-aided, and NCLP schools from pre-primary to Class 8.

name.en: National Social Assistance Programme - Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
name.hi: राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम - वृद्धावस्था पेंशन

benefitDescription.en: Central contribution: ₹200/month (age 60-79), ₹500/month (age 80+). States add their share. For BPL elderly.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL persons aged 60 years and above. Higher pension for 80+.

benefitDescription.en: Central contribution: ₹300/month (age 40-79), ₹500/month (age 80+) for BPL widows. States add their share.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL widows aged 40 years and above.

benefitDescription.en: Central contribution: ₹300/month (age 18-79), ₹500/month (age 80+) for BPL disabled persons with 80%+ disability.

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL persons aged 18+ with 80% or more disability.

benefitDescription.en: ₹20,000 lump sum to BPL household on death of primary breadwinner (age 18-59).
benefitDescription.hi: मुख्य कमाने वाले (18-59 वर्ष) की मृत्यु पर BPL परिवार को ₹20,000 एकमुश्त।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: BPL household where primary breadwinner (age 18-59) has died.

benefitDescription.en: Universal Account Number (UAN) for unorganised workers. ₹2 lakh accidental insurance (PMSBY). Gateway to access various social security schemes.
benefitDescription.hi: असंगठित श्रमिकों के लिए UAN कार्ड। ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा (PMSBY)। विभिन्न सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजनाओं तक पहुँच।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Unorganised sector workers (construction, gig, domestic, street vendor, migrant, etc.). Must have Aadhaar and mobile number.

benefitDescription.en: 5 kg free foodgrains (rice/wheat) per person per month to ~81.35 crore beneficiaries under NFSA. Extended till December 2028.
benefitDescription.hi: NFSA के ~81.35 करोड़ लाभार्थियों को प्रति व्यक्ति 5 किलो मुफ्त अनाज (चावल/गेहूं) प्रति माह। दिसंबर 2028 तक।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Beneficiaries covered under National Food Security Act (NFSA) - Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH).

benefitDescription.en: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, ₹30,000 life cover, overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.
benefitDescription.hi: शून्य शेष बैंक खाता, रुपे कार्ड, ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा, ₹30,000 जीवन बीमा, ₹10,000 ओवरड्राफ्ट।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Any Indian citizen who does not have a bank account. Minor (10+) can open with guardian.

benefitDescription.en: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000 after age 60, based on contribution. Government co-contributes 50% (max ₹1,000/year) for non-taxpayers who joined before 2020.
benefitDescription.hi: 60 वर्ष बाद ₹1,000-₹5,000 गारंटीड मासिक पेंशन। योगदान के अनुसार।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Indian citizen aged 18-40 with savings bank account. Must not be income tax payer (for govt co-contribution). Minimum 20 years contribution.

benefitDescription.en: Free LPG connection (deposit-free) with first refill and stove free of cost. ₹300 subsidy per refill for eligible beneficiaries.
benefitDescription.hi: मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन (जमा-मुक्त), पहली रिफिल और चूल्हा मुफ्त। पात्र लाभार्थियों को ₹300/रिफिल सब्सिडी।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Adult woman from BPL household. Must not already have LPG connection. Aadhaar and bank account required.

name.en: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
name.hi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना

benefitDescription.en: Subsidy up to ₹78,000 for rooftop solar installation. 300 free electricity units per month. ₹30,000 for 1kW, ₹60,000 for 2kW, ₹78,000 for 3kW+.
benefitDescription.hi: छत पर सोलर पैनल लगाने पर ₹78,000 तक सब्सिडी। 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली प्रति माह।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Residential households with grid-connected electricity. Must have suitable rooftop space. 1 crore households targeted.

benefitDescription.en: Holistic development of tribal villages covering 63,000+ villages and 5 crore tribal people. Infrastructure, health, education, livelihood convergence.
benefitDescription.hi: 63,000+ आदिवासी गाँवों का समग्र विकास। अवसंरचना, स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, आजीविका।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Tribal communities in identified tribal villages. Covers 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).

benefitDescription.en: 35 kg foodgrains per family per month at highly subsidised rates (₹2/kg wheat, ₹3/kg rice) for poorest of poor families. Now free under PMGKAY.
benefitDescription.hi: सबसे गरीब परिवारों को 35 किलो अनाज प्रति परिवार प्रति माह। PMGKAY के तहत अब मुफ्त।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Poorest of the poor families - landless labourers, marginal farmers, artisans, widows, disabled, destitute.

name.hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना

benefitDescription.en: Free skill training (576+ hours) with placement support for rural youth from poor families. Training cost ₹25,696-₹1 lakh+ per candidate borne by govt.
benefitDescription.hi: गरीब परिवारों के ग्रामीण युवाओं को मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण और प्लेसमेंट सहायता।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Rural youth from poor families (SECC 2011). SC/ST/women/PWD/minorities get age relaxation up to 45 years.

benefitDescription.en: 40-60% subsidy for fisheries infrastructure, fish farming, cold chain, and insurance. ₹20,050 crore outlay. Promotes blue revolution.
benefitDescription.hi: मत्स्य पालन अवसंरचना, मछली पालन, कोल्ड चेन पर 40-60% सब्सिडी। ₹20,050 करोड़ बजट।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, FFPOs, entrepreneurs in fisheries sector. Higher subsidy for SC/ST/women.

benefitDescription.en: Property cards (legal ownership) for rural inhabited areas using drone survey. Enables using property as financial asset for loans.
benefitDescription.hi: ड्रोन सर्वेक्षण से ग्रामीण आबादी क्षेत्रों के लिए संपत्ति कार्ड (कानूनी स्वामित्व)। ऋण के लिए संपत्ति उपयोग।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Rural property owners in Abadi (inhabited) areas of villages.

benefitDescription.en: 14,500+ schools upgraded as model schools with NEP 2020 implementation, smart classrooms, labs, sports facilities, and holistic education.
benefitDescription.hi: 14,500+ स्कूलों को NEP 2020, स्मार्ट कक्षाओं, प्रयोगशालाओं के साथ मॉडल स्कूलों में उन्नत।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students in selected PM SHRI schools (government and government-aided schools).

benefitDescription.en: One-stop portal for 20+ central scholarship schemes including pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means for SC/ST/OBC/minorities/EBC students.
benefitDescription.hi: SC/ST/OBC/अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के लिए 20+ केंद्रीय छात्रवृत्ति योजनाओं का एकल पोर्टल।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students from SC/ST/OBC/minority/EBC categories studying in recognized institutions. Income criteria vary by scheme.

name.en: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan
name.hi: पीएम गति शक्ति राष्ट्रीय मास्टर प्लान

benefitDescription.en: Integrated digital platform for coordinated infrastructure planning across 16 ministries. ₹100 lakh crore infrastructure investment. Reduces logistics costs.
benefitDescription.hi: 16 मंत्रालयों में समन्वित बुनियादी ढाँचा नियोजन हेतु एकीकृत डिजिटल प्लेटफार्म।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Policy/infrastructure initiative. Benefits all citizens through improved connectivity and logistics.

benefitDescription.en: ₹3,000/month pension after age 60 for small and marginal farmers. Monthly contribution ₹55-200 (age-based). Government matches equal contribution.
benefitDescription.hi: 60 वर्ष बाद छोटे किसानों को ₹3,000/माह पेंशन। मासिक योगदान ₹55-200। सरकार बराबर का योगदान।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares. Must not be covered under NPS/ESIC/EPFO.

benefitDescription.en: ₹3,000/month pension after age 60 for unorganised workers. Monthly contribution ₹55-200. Government matches equal contribution.
benefitDescription.hi: 60 वर्ष बाद असंगठित श्रमिकों को ₹3,000/माह पेंशन। मासिक योगदान ₹55-200।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Unorganised workers with monthly income up to ₹15,000. Must not be covered under NPS/ESIC/EPFO. Must not be income tax payer.

benefitDescription.en: Integrated support for women affected by violence: medical aid, legal assistance, psycho-social counselling, police facilitation, temporary shelter. 700+ centres operational.
benefitDescription.hi: हिंसा से प्रभावित महिलाओं को एकीकृत सहायता: चिकित्सा, कानूनी, मनोसामाजिक परामर्श, पुलिस, अस्थायी आश्रय।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women affected by violence, irrespective of age, class, caste, or marital status. Also serves girls under 18.

benefitDescription.en: Umbrella programme for digital infrastructure, e-governance, and digital literacy. Includes BharatNet, DigiLocker, UMANG, Common Service Centres.
benefitDescription.hi: डिजिटल अवसंरचना, ई-गवर्नेंस और डिजिटल साक्षरता का व्यापक कार्यक्रम।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All Indian citizens. Various sub-schemes have specific eligibility criteria.

benefitDescription.en: Unique 14-digit health ID for digital health records. Links health records across hospitals and labs under Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.
benefitDescription.hi: डिजिटल स्वास्थ्य रिकॉर्ड के लिए 14 अंकों की विशिष्ट स्वास्थ्य आईडी।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All Indian citizens with Aadhaar or driving licence. Free to create.

benefitDescription.en: ₹5,000/month stipend for 12-month internship in top 500 companies. ₹6,000 one-time grant. 1 crore youth in 5 years. Announced in Budget 2024.
benefitDescription.hi: शीर्ष 500 कंपनियों में 12 माह इंटर्नशिप पर ₹5,000/माह वजीफा। ₹6,000 एकमुश्त अनुदान।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Youth aged 21-24 not employed full-time and not in full-time education. Family income below ₹8 lakh/year. Priority to SC/ST/OBC/PwD.

benefitDescription.en: Flexible funding to states for agriculture and allied sector development based on local agro-climatic conditions. Includes Soil Health, organic farming, etc.
benefitDescription.hi: स्थानीय कृषि-जलवायु परिस्थितियों के अनुसार कृषि विकास हेतु राज्यों को लचीला वित्तपोषण।

eligibility.additionalCriteria: State-level scheme implementation. Farmers access benefits through state agriculture departments.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2,000/month to women head of household via DBT
benefitDescription.hi: परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000/माह DBT के माध्यम से

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Woman must be head of household. One woman per family. Must hold BPL/Antyodaya/Priority ration card. Government employees and income tax payers excluded.

benefitDescription.en: Free electricity up to 200 units/month for domestic consumers
benefitDescription.kn: ಗೃಹ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ 200 ಯೂನಿಟ್‌ವರೆಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್
benefitDescription.hi: घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं के लिए 200 यूनिट/माह तक मुफ्त बिजली

eligibility.additionalCriteria: One connection per household. Must be domestic (residential) electricity connection. Consumption above 200 units will be charged normally.

benefitDescription.en: 10 kg of rice per person per month free (5 kg from state + 5 kg from NFSA) for BPL/Antyodaya families
benefitDescription.kn: BPL/ಅಂತ್ಯೋದಯ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ 10 ಕೆ.ಜಿ. ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಉಚಿತ
benefitDescription.hi: BPL/अंत्योदय परिवारों को प्रति व्यक्ति 10 किलो चावल/माह मुफ्त

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have BPL/Antyodaya/Priority ration card issued by Karnataka government.

benefitDescription.en: Free travel for all women on KSRTC and BMTC government buses
benefitDescription.kn: KSRTC ಮತ್ತು BMTC ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಬಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ
benefitDescription.hi: KSRTC और BMTC सरकारी बसों में सभी महिलाओं को मुफ्त यात्रा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women can avail free travel on non-AC government buses (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, NEKRTC). Must carry valid ID.

benefitDescription.en: ₹3,000/month for graduate and ₹1,500/month for diploma unemployed youth for up to 2 years
benefitDescription.kn: ಪದವಿಧರರಿಗೆ ₹3,000/ತಿಂಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಯುವಕರಿಗೆ ₹1,500/ತಿಂಗಳು 2 ವರ್ಷಗಳವರೆಗೆ
benefitDescription.hi: स्नातकों को ₹3,000/माह और डिप्लोमा बेरोजगार युवाओं को ₹1,500/माह 2 वर्षों तक

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have graduated from a Karnataka government/aided college or polytechnic. Must be registered on employment exchange. Family annual income should not exceed certain limits.

benefitDescription.en: Scholarships and hostel fee reimbursement for SC/ST/OBC students pursuing higher education
benefitDescription.kn: ಉನ್ನತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ SC/ST/OBC ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ವೇತನ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸ್ಟೆಲ್ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ
benefitDescription.hi: उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त SC/ST/OBC छात्रों को छात्रवृत्ति और हॉस्टल शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a Karnataka domicile pursuing post-matric education. Family annual income limit applies.

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000 bond at girl child's birth (matures to ~₹1 lakh at age 18) plus annual scholarships for BPL families
benefitDescription.kn: ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಗುವಿನ ಜನನದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ₹25,000 ಬಾಂಡ್ (18 ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ~₹1 ಲಕ್ಷ) ಜೊತೆಗೆ BPL ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ವೇತನ
benefitDescription.hi: बालिका जन्म पर ₹25,000 बॉन्ड (18 वर्ष में ~₹1 लाख) और BPL परिवारों के लिए वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girl child must be born in a BPL family. Family annual income must be below ₹1.2 lakh. Birth must be registered within 1 year. Only for first two girl children.

benefitDescription.en: Subsidy for farm ponds, polyhouse, drip irrigation and other water harvesting structures for rainfed farmers
benefitDescription.kn: ಮಳೆಯಾಶ್ರಿತ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಹೊಂಡ, ಪಾಲಿಹೌಸ್, ಹನಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಜಲ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ರಚನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯಧನ
benefitDescription.hi: वर्षा आधारित किसानों को फार्म पॉन्ड, पॉलीहाउस, ड्रिप सिंचाई के लिए सब्सिडी

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a rainfed area farmer in Karnataka. Land holding limit applies. SC/ST farmers get higher subsidy.

benefitDescription.en: ₹600/month old age pension for senior citizens from BPL families
benefitDescription.kn: BPL ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಹಿರಿಯ ನಾಗರಿಕರಿಗೆ ₹600/ತಿಂಗಳು ವೃದ್ಧಾಪ್ಯ ಪಿಂಚಣಿ
benefitDescription.hi: BPL परिवारों के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को ₹600/माह वृद्धावस्था पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be 65 years or above. Must belong to BPL family. Karnataka domicile.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month to women head of family via DBT (over 1.15 crore beneficiaries)
benefitDescription.ta: குடும்பத் தலைவிகளுக்கு மாதம் ₹1,000 நேரடி பண மாற்றம்
benefitDescription.hi: परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹1,000/माह DBT

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Woman must be head of household. Must have ration card (rice card). Government employees and income tax payers excluded. One woman per family.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month stipend for girl students from government school backgrounds pursuing higher education
benefitDescription.ta: அரசு பள்ளிகளில் படித்த பெண் மாணவர்களுக்கு மாதம் ₹1,000 உதவித்தொகை
benefitDescription.hi: सरकारी स्कूल से उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त छात्राओं को ₹1,000/माह

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have studied Class 6-12 in Tamil Nadu government schools. Must be pursuing undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI. Credited directly to student's bank account.

benefitDescription.en: Free skill development and employability training for college students with industry certifications
benefitDescription.ta: கல்லூரி மாணவர்களுக்கு இலவச திறன் மேம்பாடு மற்றும் வேலைவாய்ப்பு பயிற்சி
benefitDescription.hi: कॉलेज छात्रों के लिए मुफ्त कौशल विकास और रोजगार प्रशिक्षण

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be enrolled in any college/university in Tamil Nadu. Courses include AI, data science, soft skills, etc. Available through Naan Mudhalvan portal.

name.hi: विडियल पयनम (महिलाओं के लिए मुफ्त बस)

benefitDescription.en: Free travel for all women and transgender persons on government town buses across Tamil Nadu
benefitDescription.ta: தமிழ்நாடு முழுவதும் அரசு நகர பேருந்துகளில் அனைத்து பெண்கள் மற்றும் திருநங்கைகளுக்கும் இலவச பயணம்
benefitDescription.hi: तमिलनाडु में सरकारी बसों में सभी महिलाओं और ट्रांसजेंडर को मुफ्त यात्रा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women and transgender persons. Valid on government town buses (non-AC). No registration required.

benefitDescription.en: Free nutritious breakfast for government school students (Classes 1-5) on all working days
benefitDescription.ta: அரசுப் பள்ளி மாணவர்களுக்கு (வகுப்பு 1-5) அனைத்து வேலை நாட்களிலும் இலவச சத்தான காலை உணவு
benefitDescription.hi: सरकारी स्कूल के छात्रों (कक्षा 1-5) को सभी कार्य दिवसों में मुफ्त पौष्टिक नाश्ता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students of Classes 1-5 in Tamil Nadu government and government-aided schools.

benefitDescription.en: Road safety scheme providing free emergency medical treatment and ₹1 lakh accident relief for road accident victims
benefitDescription.ta: சாலை விபத்தில் பாதிக்கப்பட்டவர்களுக்கு இலவச அவசர சிகிச்சை மற்றும் ₹1 லட்சம் நிவாரணம்
benefitDescription.hi: सड़क दुर्घटना पीड़ितों को मुफ्त आपातकालीन चिकित्सा और ₹1 लाख राहत

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Any road accident victim in Tamil Nadu. Treated free at empanelled hospitals within 48 hours of accident.

benefitDescription.en: Free medical treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year at empanelled hospitals for families with annual income below ₹1.2 lakh
benefitDescription.ta: ஆண்டு வருமானம் ₹1.2 லட்சத்திற்கு கீழ் உள்ள குடும்பங்களுக்கு ₹5 லட்சம் வரை இலவச மருத்துவ சிகிச்சை
benefitDescription.hi: ₹1.2 लाख से कम वार्षिक आय वाले परिवारों को ₹5 लाख तक मुफ्त चिकित्सा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have family annual income below ₹1.2 lakh. Must hold valid ration card. Covers 1,027+ medical procedures.

name.ta: மூவலூர் ராமமிர்தம் அம்மையார் திருமண உதவித் திட்டம்

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000 marriage assistance + 8g gold for making Thirumangalyam for women graduates from poor families
benefitDescription.ta: ஏழைக் குடும்பங்களைச் சேர்ந்த பெண் பட்டதாரிகளுக்கு ₹25,000 திருமண உதவி + 8 கிராம் தங்கம்
benefitDescription.hi: गरीब परिवारों की महिला स्नातकों को ₹25,000 विवाह सहायता + 8 ग्राम सोना

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Bride must be a degree holder (graduation). Family must hold ration card. First marriage only. Different amounts for different education levels.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month pension for destitute elderly persons aged 60+
benefitDescription.ta: 60 வயதுக்கு மேற்பட்ட ஆதரவற்ற முதியோருக்கு மாதம் ₹1,000 ஓய்வூதியம்
benefitDescription.hi: 60+ आयु के निराश्रित बुजुर्गों को ₹1,000/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be 60 years or above. Must be destitute. Must be resident of Tamil Nadu.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,600/month pension for elderly (60+), widows, disabled, and unmarried women from BPL families
benefitDescription.ml: BPL കുടുംബങ്ങളിലെ വയോജനങ്ങൾ (60+), വിധവകൾ, വികലാംഗർ, അവിവാഹിത സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് ₹1,600/മാസം
benefitDescription.hi: BPL परिवारों के बुजुर्ग (60+), विधवा, विकलांग को ₹1,600/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Six types: Old Age, Widow, Agricultural Worker, Disability, Unmarried Women (50+), and Physically Disabled. Must be Kerala resident. Must be BPL. Applied through local self-government (Panchayat/Municipality).

benefitDescription.en: Free houses for homeless and landless families — ₹4 lakh subsidy for house construction, flats for urban landless
benefitDescription.ml: ഭവനരഹിതരായ കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്ക് സൗജന്യ വീട് — വീട് നിർമ്മാണത്തിന് ₹4 ലക്ഷം സബ്‌സിഡി
benefitDescription.hi: बेघर परिवारों को मुफ्त घर — निर्माण के लिए ₹4 लाख सब्सिडी

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be identified as homeless or living in dilapidated house. Beneficiary list prepared by local self-government bodies. Priority for SC/ST, fishermen, and differently-abled.

benefitDescription.en: ₹300/month for orphan children (Class 1-5), ₹500/month (Class 6-10), ₹750/month (Plus Two), ₹1,000/month (degree) through Social Security Mission
benefitDescription.hi: अनाथ बच्चों को ₹300-₹1,000/माह शिक्षा सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be an orphan (lost one or both parents) living with family/relatives, not in institutional care. Must be studying in a recognized school/college in Kerala.

benefitDescription.en: ₹6/litre milk subsidy to dairy farmers and support for cow rearing to boost milk production in Kerala
benefitDescription.ml: ക്ഷീരകർഷകർക്ക് ലിറ്ററിന് ₹6 പാൽ സബ്‌സിഡി, പശുവളർത്തൽ പിന്തുണ
benefitDescription.hi: डेयरी किसानों को ₹6/लीटर दूध सब्सिडी और गाय पालन सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a dairy farmer in Kerala. Milk must be supplied through registered dairy cooperative societies.

benefitDescription.en: Free treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year at empanelled hospitals for BPL families (integrated with Ayushman Bharat)
benefitDescription.ml: BPL കുടുംബങ്ങൾക്ക് എംപാനൽഡ് ആശുപത്രികളിൽ ₹5 ലക്ഷം വരെ സൗജന്യ ചികിത്സ
benefitDescription.hi: BPL परिवारों को ₹5 लाख/वर्ष तक मुफ्त इलाज

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) card. Available to SECC-listed and ration card holding families. Covers 1,600+ medical procedures.

benefitDescription.en: Financial assistance for medical treatment, natural disaster relief, and other emergencies — up to ₹2 lakh for critical illness
benefitDescription.ml: ചികിത്സ, പ്രകൃതിദുരന്തം, അടിയന്തര സഹായം — ഗുരുതര രോഗങ്ങൾക്ക് ₹2 ലക്ഷം വരെ
benefitDescription.hi: चिकित्सा, प्राकृतिक आपदा राहत — गंभीर बीमारी के लिए ₹2 लाख तक

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Kerala residents facing medical emergencies, natural disasters, or other distress situations. Application through District Collector or online portal.

benefitDescription.en: Government-backed chitty (chit fund) schemes with various denominations for savings and emergency financial needs
benefitDescription.ml: വിവിധ തുകകളിൽ സർക്കാർ ചിട്ടി പദ്ധതികൾ — സമ്പാദ്യത്തിനും അടിയന്തര ആവശ്യത്തിനും
benefitDescription.hi: विभिन्न राशियों में सरकारी चिट फंड योजनाएं

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Open to all Kerala residents and NRKs (Non-Resident Keralites). Various chitty denominations available from ₹1 lakh to ₹50 lakh.

benefitDescription.en: Complete fee waiver for SC/ST/BPL students in government and aided colleges in Kerala
benefitDescription.ml: സർക്കാർ, എയ്ഡഡ് കോളേജുകളിൽ SC/ST/BPL വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾക്ക് പൂർണ ഫീസ് ഇളവ്
benefitDescription.hi: सरकारी/सहायता प्राप्त कॉलेजों में SC/ST/BPL छात्रों को पूर्ण शुल्क छूट

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be enrolled in a government or government-aided institution in Kerala. BPL families also eligible regardless of category.

benefitDescription.en: ₹4,000/month pension for elderly (60+), widows, disabled, weavers, fishermen, toddy tappers, and other vulnerable groups
benefitDescription.te: వృద్ధులు (60+), వితంతువులు, వికలాంగులు, చేనేత కార్మికులకు నెలకు ₹4,000 పెన్షన్
benefitDescription.hi: बुजुर्ग (60+), विधवा, विकलांग, बुनकरों को ₹4,000/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Covers old age (60+), widows, disabled (40%+), weavers, fishermen, toddy tappers, single women, transgender, PLHIV, dappu artists, cobblers. Enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 by TDP government in 2024. Part of Super Six promises.

benefitDescription.en: ₹15,000/year to mothers of school-going children (Classes 1-12) to encourage children's education
benefitDescription.te: పాఠశాల విద్యార్థుల తల్లులకు విద్యా ప్రోత్సాహంగా సంవత్సరానికి ₹15,000
benefitDescription.hi: स्कूली बच्चों की माताओं को शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन हेतु ₹15,000/वर्ष

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Mother/guardian of children studying in government/aided schools (Classes 1-12). Replaces the earlier Amma Vodi scheme. Part of Super Six promises. Launched June 2025.

benefitDescription.en: ₹20,000/year investment support to farmers for crop cultivation (replaces YSR Rythu Bharosa)
benefitDescription.te: పంట సాగు కోసం రైతులకు సంవత్సరానికి ₹20,000 పెట్టుబడి సహాయం
benefitDescription.hi: फसल खेती के लिए किसानों को ₹20,000/वर्ष निवेश सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a farmer with cultivable land in AP. Part of Super Six promises. Replaces previous Rythu Bharosa scheme. Announced in Budget 2025-26.

benefitDescription.en: 3 free LPG gas cylinders per year to eligible women-headed households
benefitDescription.te: అర్హత ఉన్న మహిళా కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి 3 ఉచిత LPG గ్యాస్ సిలిండర్లు
benefitDescription.hi: पात्र महिला प्रधान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष 3 मुफ्त LPG सिलेंडर

eligibility.additionalCriteria: LPG connection must be in woman's name. Must have white ration card (BPL). Part of Super Six promises. Already implemented.

name.hi: स्त्री शक्ति (महिलाओं के लिए मुफ्त बस)

benefitDescription.en: Free travel for all women on APSRTC government buses across Andhra Pradesh
benefitDescription.te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ లో APSRTC ప్రభుత్వ బస్సులలో అన్ని మహిళలకు ఉచిత ప్రయాణం
benefitDescription.hi: आंध्र प्रदेश में APSRTC बसों में सभी महिलाओं को मुफ्त यात्रा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women in AP. Valid on APSRTC non-AC buses. Launched 15th August 2025. Part of Super Six promises.

benefitDescription.en: Subsidised meals at ₹5 (breakfast) and ₹10 (lunch/dinner) at Anna Canteens across AP
benefitDescription.hi: अन्ना कैंटीन में ₹5 (नाश्ता), ₹10 (दोपहर/रात्रि भोजन)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Open to all. Canteens located in major urban centres across Andhra Pradesh. Reopened by TDP government as part of Super Six.

benefitDescription.en: Full tuition fee reimbursement for students from families with income below ₹2.5 lakh pursuing higher education
benefitDescription.te: ₹2.5 లక్షల కంటే తక్కువ ఆదాయం ఉన్న కుటుంబాల విద్యార్థులకు పూర్తి ట్యూషన్ ఫీజు చెల్లింపు
benefitDescription.hi: ₹2.5 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों के छात्रों को पूर्ण ट्यूशन फीस प्रतिपूर्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be pursuing ITI/Polytechnic/Degree/PG/Professional courses in AP. Family annual income below ₹2.5 lakh. Continued from previous government with modifications.

benefitDescription.en: ₹10,000/year financial assistance to auto-rickshaw and taxi drivers for vehicle maintenance
benefitDescription.te: ఆటో డ్రైవర్లు, టాక్సీ డ్రైవర్లకు వాహన నిర్వహణ కోసం సంవత్సరానికి ₹10,000
benefitDescription.hi: ऑटो/टैक्सी ड्राइवरों को वाहन रखरखाव के लिए ₹10,000/वर्ष

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be registered auto-rickshaw/taxi driver in AP. Must have valid driving license and vehicle registration.

benefitDescription.en: ₹12,000/acre/year (₹6,000 per season) investment support to farmers — increased from ₹10,000 by Congress govt
benefitDescription.hi: किसानों को ₹12,000/एकड़/वर्ष (₹6,000 प्रति सीजन) निवेश सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must own agricultural land in Telangana. Renamed from Rythu Bandhu to Rythu Bharosa by Congress government on 26 Jan 2025. Amount increased from ₹10,000 to ₹12,000/acre/year.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2,500/month pension for elderly, widows, disabled, weavers, toddy tappers, beedi workers (₹3,016 for severely disabled)
benefitDescription.hi: बुजुर्ग, विधवा, विकलांगों को ₹2,500/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Old age (57+), widows, disabled (40%+), weavers, toddy tappers, beedi workers, PLHIV, filariasis patients. Renamed from Aasara to Cheyutha by Congress government. Enhanced amounts.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,00,116 one-time marriage assistance for women from BPL families (Kalyana Lakshmi for Hindu, Shaadi Mubarak for Muslim families)
benefitDescription.hi: BPL परिवारों की महिलाओं को विवाह सहायता ₹1,00,116

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Bride must be 18+ years. Family must hold white ration card. Telangana domicile for 10+ years. Must apply before or within 1 year of marriage. First marriage only.

benefitDescription.en: Free 2BHK houses (560 sq ft) for homeless poor families in urban and rural areas of Telangana
benefitDescription.te: తెలంగాణలో నిరాశ్రయ పేద కుటుంబాలకు ఉచిత 2BHK ఇళ్ళు (560 చ.అ.)
benefitDescription.hi: तेलंगाना में बेघर गरीब परिवारों को मुफ्त 2BHK घर (560 वर्ग फीट)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be landless/homeless in Telangana. Must have white ration card. Priority for SC/ST/BC/Minority. Congress government renamed it as Indiramma Illu and continued the scheme.

benefitDescription.en: Full tuition fee reimbursement for students from families earning below ₹2.5 lakh/year pursuing professional/degree courses
benefitDescription.te: ₹2.5 లక్షల లోపు ఆదాయం ఉన్న కుటుంబాల విద్యార్థులకు పూర్తి ట్యూషన్ ఫీజు చెల్లింపు
benefitDescription.hi: ₹2.5 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों के छात्रों को पूर्ण ट्यूशन फीस प्रतिपूर्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be pursuing degree/professional courses in Telangana. Family annual income must be below ₹2.5 lakh. Must have Aadhaar-linked bank account.

benefitDescription.en: Free treatment up to ₹5 lakh/year at network hospitals for BPL families for serious ailments
benefitDescription.te: BPL కుటుంబాలకు తీవ్రమైన వ్యాధులకు నెట్‌వర్క్ ఆసుపత్రులలో ₹5 లక్షల వరకు ఉచిత చికిత్స
benefitDescription.hi: BPL परिवारों को गंभीर बीमारियों के लिए ₹5 लाख/वर्ष तक मुफ्त इलाज

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must hold white ration card. Covers 1,000+ surgical procedures. Integrated with Ayushman Bharat PMJAY.

benefitDescription.en: Free electricity up to 200 units/month for domestic consumers — Congress government's guarantee scheme
benefitDescription.te: గృహ వినియోగదారులకు నెలకు 200 యూనిట్ల వరకు ఉచిత విద్యుత్
benefitDescription.hi: घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को 200 यूनिट/माह तक मुफ्त बिजली

eligibility.additionalCriteria: One domestic connection per household. Congress government guarantee. Consumption above 200 units charged normally.

benefitDescription.en: Free life insurance of ₹5 lakh for all registered farmers aged 18-59 — premium paid by state government
benefitDescription.te: 18-59 సంవత్సరాల నమోదిత రైతులకు ₹5 లక్షల ఉచిత జీవిత బీమా
benefitDescription.hi: 18-59 वर्ष के पंजीकृत किसानों को ₹5 लाख मुफ्त जीवन बीमा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be a registered pattadar (land-owning farmer) in Telangana. Premium of ~₹2,271/year paid entirely by the state government.

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,500/month (age 55-59), ₹2,000/month (age 60-79), ₹3,000/month (age 80+) pension for elderly, widows, and destitute

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be resident of Puducherry for at least 5 years. Covers old age, widows, deserted women, unmarried women, and transgender persons. Enhanced pension amounts recently increased.

name.hi: BPL वधुओं के लिए विवाह सहायता

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000 one-time financial assistance for marriage of poor brides from BPL families
benefitDescription.ta: BPL குடும்பங்களின் ஏழை மணப்பெண்களுக்கு ₹25,000 ஒரு முறை திருமண உதவி
benefitDescription.hi: BPL परिवारों की गरीब वधुओं को ₹25,000 एकमुश्त विवाह सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be first marriage. Annual family income should not exceed ₹24,000. Bride must be resident of Puducherry. Applied through Dept of Women & Child Development.

benefitDescription.en: Monthly unemployment allowance to registered unemployed youth in Puducherry
benefitDescription.ta: புதுச்சேரியில் பதிவு செய்யப்பட்ட வேலையில்லாத இளைஞர்களுக்கு மாதாந்திர வேலையின்மை உதவித்தொகை
benefitDescription.hi: पुडुचेरी में पंजीकृत बेरोजगार युवाओं को मासिक बेरोजगारी भत्ता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be registered with Employment Exchange in Puducherry. Must be resident of Puducherry UT.

name.en: Free Supply of Rice to Poor People

benefitDescription.en: 10 kg of free rice through fair-price shops during festivals and natural calamities
benefitDescription.ta: பண்டிகை நாட்கள் மற்றும் இயற்கை பேரிடர் நேரத்தில் நியாய விலை கடைகள் மூலம் 10 கிலோ இலவச அரிசி
benefitDescription.hi: त्योहारों और प्राकृतिक आपदाओं में उचित मूल्य दुकानों से 10 किलो मुफ्त चावल

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must hold ration card issued by Puducherry government. Distributed during Pongal, Deepavali, and natural calamities.

name.ta: SC/ST மாணவர்களுக்கான பட்டய சான்றிதழுக்கு பிறகான உதவித்தொகை
name.hi: SC/ST छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

benefitDescription.en: Full tuition fees and maintenance allowance for SC/ST students pursuing post-matric education in Puducherry
benefitDescription.ta: புதுச்சேரியில் உயர்நிலைக் கல்வி பயிலும் SC/ST மாணவர்களுக்கு முழு கல்வி கட்டணம் மற்றும் பராமரிப்பு உதவித்தொகை
benefitDescription.hi: पुडुचेरी में उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त SC/ST छात्रों को पूर्ण शुल्क और रखरखाव भत्ता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be domicile of Puducherry. Must belong to SC/ST community. Family annual income must be below ₹2.5 lakh.

benefitDescription.en: ₹2,000/month pension for persons with disabilities (40%+ disability) in Puducherry
benefitDescription.hi: पुडुचेरी में विकलांग व्यक्तियों (40%+ विकलांगता) को ₹2,000/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have 40% or more disability as certified by medical board. Must be resident of Puducherry.

benefitDescription.en: Fixed deposit of ₹50,000 at girl's birth (₹1 lakh for BPL) maturing at age 18, plus annual scholarships
benefitDescription.ta: பெண் குழந்தை பிறக்கும் போது ₹50,000 நிலையான வைப்பு (BPL-க்கு ₹1 லட்சம்), 18 வயதில் முதிர்வு
benefitDescription.hi: बालिका जन्म पर ₹50,000 FD (BPL को ₹1 लाख), 18 वर्ष में परिपक्व

eligibility.additionalCriteria: For girl children born in Puducherry. Parents must be residents. Higher benefit for BPL families. Only for first two girl children.

benefitDescription.en: ₹25,000 total across 6 stages from birth to graduation
benefitDescription.hi: जन्म से स्नातक तक 6 चरणों में कुल ₹25,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Max 2 daughters per family

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000 per month pension for elderly citizens aged 60+
benefitDescription.hi: 60 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के वृद्ध नागरिकों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Below poverty line families

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000 per month pension for widows aged 18-60
benefitDescription.hi: 18-60 वर्ष की विधवा महिलाओं को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Widow women from BPL families

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000 per month pension for persons with 40%+ disability
benefitDescription.hi: 40% से अधिक विकलांगता वाले व्यक्तियों को ₹1,000 प्रति माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Minimum 40% disability certificate required

benefitDescription.en: ₹51,000 one-time grant for marriage of daughters from economically weaker families
benefitDescription.hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की बेटियों की शादी के लिए ₹51,000 का एकमुश्त अनुदान

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Rural income max ₹46,080, Urban income max ₹56,460 for General; ₹3 lakh for SC/ST/OBC

benefitDescription.en: Affordable housing for economically weaker sections in urban areas
benefitDescription.hi: शहरी क्षेत्रों में आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों के लिए सस्ते आवास

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Should not own a pucca house

benefitDescription.en: Free wheat, rice, sugar and kerosene to BPL/AAY/PHH families via ration card
benefitDescription.hi: बीपीएल/अंत्योदय/प्राथमिकता परिवारों को मुफ्त गेहूं, चावल, चीनी और मिट्टी का तेल

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have valid ration card (BPL/AAY/PHH)

benefitDescription.en: Women safety and empowerment mission — awareness, anti-trafficking, skill training, legal aid
benefitDescription.hi: महिला सुरक्षा और सशक्तिकरण मिशन — जागरूकता, तस्करी विरोधी, कौशल प्रशिक्षण, कानूनी सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All women of Uttar Pradesh

benefitDescription.en: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarships for SC/ST/OBC/Minority students
benefitDescription.hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति/अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग/अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के लिए प्री-मैट्रिक और पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be enrolled in recognized educational institution in UP

benefitDescription.en: ₹50,000 on graduation completion for girls; additional benefits at birth, vaccination, school stages
benefitDescription.hi: स्नातक पूरा करने पर बालिकाओं को ₹50,000; जन्म, टीकाकरण, विद्यालय स्तर पर अतिरिक्त लाभ

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be resident of Bihar; max 2 daughters per family

benefitDescription.en: Education loan up to ₹4 lakh at 0% interest for higher education after 12th
benefitDescription.hi: 12वीं के बाद उच्च शिक्षा के लिए 0% ब्याज पर ₹4 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have passed 12th from Bihar; admitted in recognized institution

benefitDescription.en: ₹3,000 for purchase of bicycle for class 9 students
benefitDescription.hi: कक्षा 9 के छात्रों को साइकिल खरीदने के लिए ₹3,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must be enrolled in class 9 in a government school in Bihar

benefitDescription.en: ₹500/month pension for elderly aged 60+ (₹400 for 60-79, ₹500 for 80+)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: All elderly residents of Bihar (universal, no income limit)

benefitDescription.en: ₹600-₹1,500 per year for school uniforms for classes 1-12 students
benefitDescription.hi: कक्षा 1-12 के छात्रों के लिए स्कूल यूनिफॉर्म हेतु ₹600-₹1,500 प्रति वर्ष

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Students enrolled in Bihar government schools

benefitDescription.en: ₹1.20 lakh financial assistance for building pucca house in rural areas
benefitDescription.hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में पक्का मकान बनाने के लिए ₹1.20 लाख की वित्तीय सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Homeless or living in kutcha house; must be on SECC/Awas+ list

benefitDescription.en: ₹10 lakh interest-free loan for SC/ST/OBC/Minority/Women entrepreneurs to start business
benefitDescription.hi: व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति/अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग/अल्पसंख्यक/महिला उद्यमियों को ₹10 लाख ब्याज मुक्त ऋण

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have passed 10+2 or ITI; resident of Bihar

benefitDescription.en: ₹15,000 (1st division) / ₹10,000 (2nd division) for SC/ST girls passing 12th
benefitDescription.hi: 12वीं पास करने वाली अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति की बालिकाओं को ₹15,000 (प्रथम श्रेणी) / ₹10,000 (द्वितीय श्रेणी)

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have passed 12th from Bihar board

benefitDescription.en: Education loan up to ₹15 lakh at 0% interest for higher studies after 10th/12th
benefitDescription.hi: 10वीं/12वीं के बाद उच्च शिक्षा के लिए 0% ब्याज पर ₹15 लाख तक का शिक्षा ऋण

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must have passed 10th/12th from Jharkhand; family income below ₹4 lakh/year

benefitDescription.en: ₹2,500-₹20,000 at various stages from class 8 to 18 years; total up to ₹40,000

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Girls from SECC-listed families; enrolled in school

benefitDescription.en: ₹2 lakh financial assistance for construction of pucca house for homeless families
benefitDescription.hi: बेघर परिवारों को पक्का मकान बनाने के लिए ₹2 लाख की वित्तीय सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Homeless families not covered under PMAY; must be on SECC list

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month pension for elderly (60+), widows, and disabled persons
benefitDescription.hi: वृद्ध (60+), विधवा और दिव्यांग व्यक्तियों को ₹1,000/माह पेंशन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Also covers widows 18+ and disabled with 40%+ disability

benefitDescription.en: ₹5,000 one-time incentive to unemployed graduate youth while seeking employment
benefitDescription.hi: रोजगार की तलाश करते समय बेरोजगार स्नातक युवाओं को ₹5,000 का एकमुश्त प्रोत्साहन

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Graduate from recognized university; registered with employment exchange

benefitDescription.en: Free health insurance up to ₹5 lakh/family/year for families not covered under Ayushman Bharat
benefitDescription.hi: आयुष्मान भारत में शामिल नहीं परिवारों के लिए ₹5 लाख/परिवार/वर्ष तक मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य बीमा

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Families not covered under PMJAY/Ayushman Bharat

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,000/month (increased to ₹2,500 promised) financial assistance for women aged 18-50
benefitDescription.hi: 18-50 आयु की महिलाओं को ₹1,000/माह (₹2,500 तक बढ़ाने का वादा) वित्तीय सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Women residents of Jharkhand; not a government employee or taxpayer

benefitDescription.en: Scholarship, skill training, and livelihood support for tribal communities
benefitDescription.hi: आदिवासी समुदायों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति, कौशल प्रशिक्षण और आजीविका सहायता

eligibility.additionalCriteria: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe community in Jharkhand

benefitDescription.en: ₹1,200/month for SC/ST women; ₹1,000/month for general category women
